counting.rule: Exactly one primary group per condition; all backend outcomes retained; properties, source variants, profiles and calibration controls do not increase N.

shared_contract.source_status: Exact source templates fixed here before results. A1 must materialize byte-identical files, check LRM legality and tool/deck validity, and freeze input hashes before execution. Any substantive source amendment creates a new card identity.
shared_contract.language_basis: LRM2.4 sections4.4,4.5,5.6,5.10,8.2; existing project operator/event contracts, not backend waveforms.
shared_contract.observation: Every required electrical port exports absolute node voltage in V and time in s. Also verify actual driven PWL values. Marker ports encode states/callbacks/phase as specified; they are read-only contributions with no loads.
shared_contract.budget_rule: Add independently bounded observation and actual-input uncertainty to measured error. P when upper bound <=budget; F when lower bound >budget; I on overlap or unqualified observations. Source event tolerance permits temporal waveform variation, not extra free voltage tolerance.
shared_contract.event_rule: One allowed event sequence per condition must explain counts, order, held sample values and every edge. cross window is one-sided min(time_tol,expr_tol/abs(slope)); input and export-time uncertainty expand it independently. Explicit timer time_tol admits [nominal-time_tol,nominal+time_tol] under LRM2.4 section5.10.3.3; non-early wording applies only to unspecified tolerance.
shared_contract.timer_boundary: No terminal timer event at stop; first event separated from initial_step. No unspecified default timer tolerance.
shared_contract.phase_rule: Ordinary abs phase error only away from wrap windows. Everywhere, circular distance min_k abs(p_expected-p_actual+k) <=phase budget. Require p in [0,1] within observation uncertainty. Sine compared to continuous unwrapped analytic phase. Separate exact-wrap observations and left/right limits; wrap count inferred from qualified bracketing records, not a DUT last_crossing report.
shared_contract.claim_limit: Maximum observed error on fixed required observations; no general continuous-time guarantee or invisible narrow-pulse detection. Qualified gap/rounding metadata is required; absence leaves relevant properties I.
calibration_required: Shared legal event-time variations across all ports
Between-sample short pulse: recognize observation limit or refine
Individually valid points with no common event history
Exact-wrap, wrong modulo/phase and offset cases
Missing columns, NaN, wrong units, non-monotone time, truncation
Two backends agreeing on the same incorrect analytic trace
shared_contract.execution_profiles: A1 freezes concrete backend settings and bounded run list; no source/tolerance adjustment after inspecting scores.
shared_contract.local_observation_rule: All required ports have qualified records with maximum gap20ps inside each prescribed window [nominal-2ns,nominal+2ns]; outside windows maximum gap200ps. Include exact nominal center rows as a separately labelled boundary cohort, and retain actual accepted-point versus interpolated-output semantics. An adapter unable to obtain this evidence marks affected properties I before scoring. Grids alone do not bound output interpolation error; qualify it separately.

sources.claim: cross after actual crossing and satisfying both time/expr tolerances
Explicit timer tolerance requires within time_tol; at-or-just-beyond wording applies to absent time_tol

shared_contract.exact_boundary_rule: Preserve all exact-nominal-wrap rows with raw phase value, ordinary scalar endpoint error, circular error, export-time uncertainty and accepted/interpolated identity. Endpoint expectation from mathematical modulo is0; a near1 value explained by timing uncertainty must be distinguished from a verified wrong endpoint. Do not erase raw endpoint discrepancies when circular distance is small. Without exact-time qualification endpoint semantics remain I, separately from qualified off-boundary phase/sine properties.
